name: browser
title: Browser rendering
description: Cloudflare Browser Rendering for Lunora — headless browser screenshots, PDFs, and HTML scraping via ctx.browser in actions. Powered by @cloudflare/playwright over the BROWSER binding.
docs: Rendering a caller-supplied URL is an SSRF sink on a metered service, so the scaffolded screenshot/pdf actions fail closed: they require an authenticated caller, accept only https: URLs whose host is listed in ALLOWED_RENDER_HOSTS (which ships EMPTY, so nothing renders until you add your hosts), and rate-limit per caller. That check sees the URL once, so it cannot follow a redirect or a subresource. Pin the same allowlist on the browser itself in your Worker entry: createShardDO({ browser: (env) => createBrowser({ allowedHosts: ["example.com"], binding: env.BROWSER, launch }) }) with import { launch } from "@cloudflare/playwright" — that is the hard guarantee, and the BROWSER binding on its own gives you none. Until you add it, codegen reports browser_user_url_without_allowlist (WARN) against both actions: that is the advisor asking for the layer this item cannot install for you, and it is meant to stand until you do. Never set allowPrivateTargets: true.
